checks.description: Prepare narrowly revised main U-Boot with required commands and exact known SPL/BL31/DT/environment; bounded SD-only loader transfer preserves FAT/root/GPT with strict identity/preimage/mount and refusal/failure checks.
Identified explicit serial U-Boot-only routing with exact boot.scr size/SHA and unchanged payload checks, bounded captures/timeouts and no blind retry/control-line changes.
Meaningful offline execution/refusal evidence, source/artifact receipts and independent verification; H12 physical routing/write/return remain pending.

Actual writer finalizer selects automatic reboot only for fully verified recovery-handoff PASS, preserves failure/nonhandoff poweroff, compiles ARM64 and demonstrates bounded guest-reset/shutdown events without repeating unchanged bulk-write evidence.

constraints.text: Pin the exact old loader/config/source/patch/toolchain inputs. Assemble only the exact 40960-byte SPL prefix SHA c4fe12c6f2d344ac48cf39d1711d30734110ee3a55bb0eda1df2fccf80610a8d plus newly built main-stage FIT. Independently extract and compare BL31/board DT and verify unchanged default environment, eGON/FIT structure, load addresses and boot integration. Effective config differences are only CMD_HASH/HASH_VERIFY/CRC32_VERIFY and individually justified required dependencies; reject unrelated drift. Verify actual linked commands and good/corrupt hash and crc32 -v semantics using compatible pinned sandbox. Give the new loader its own hash and pending physical status; old physical evidence covers only preserved components.

Enforce the absolute loader reservation endpoint: 8192 + new loader length <= 1048576, independent of any assumed first-partition start. Derive actual SD partition/GPT exclusion ranges from the admitted map (H13 prepared card p1 starts at 16 MiB; the proposal's 2 MiB statement is conservative, not its actual layout). Bind one descriptor to current controller/CID/dev_t/capacity and complete overwrite-span preimage; require kernel-readonly ro,norecovery root, unmounted boot and no writable SD mount/competing users. Recheck admission at write boundary; streaming before/after FAT/root/GPT comparisons and exact loader readback must pass. Retain complete overwrite preimage and original image for separate reviewed recovery. Report advisory ownership accurately; uncertainty stops without retry or automatic rollback. Exercise aliases, mount/identity/preimage races and partial-write/flush/readback faults offline.

Keep serial routing fixed and explicit: privately identified bridge path/topology, exclusive controller/capture arbitration, bounded countdown/prompt state and recognized U-Boot-only transmission. Require expected boot.scr byte count/SHA before source and retain every unchanged script payload check and fixed root/envelope binding. Reject unexpected identity, prompt, output, timeout or hash; no arbitrary input interpolation, Linux-shell commands, control-line/power changes or blind retry. Physical MMC mapping and fresh redundant environment/expected missed-interception attempt decrement require separate exact-operation review before any reboot; no inferred Linux-to-U-Boot numbering or claim of policy preservation after missed autoboot.

Limit finalizer change to RB_AUTOBOOT for compile-time recovery-handoff mode and exact PASS reached after existing full verified transfer. Every other status, including CLAIM_ONLY_PASS and injected/uncertain failures, and every nonhandoff build keeps RB_POWER_OFF. If reboot returns/fails, pause/stop without retry. Test the actual production finalizer using captured syscalls for both modes and representative refusal/postopen/final-environment faults, exact-versus-lookalike statuses and reboot failure. Compile the actual ARM64 variant and execute that finalizer in bounded disposable QEMU with observed guest reset/shutdown events. Keep synthetic test hooks out of production and prove admission, marker consumption, claims, environment-last transfer and full readback paths unchanged before reusing their existing evidence.

Measure isolated build scratch against 512 MiB and aggregate loader/preimage/receipt/capture against 64 MiB; preflight space and stop if bounds fail. Stream hashes without full-card copies and preserve accepted builds/evidence. Keep source/config, sandbox/native syscalls, ARM64 QEMU and measured hardware evidence separately named. Independent delivery verification is required. Physical SD write/probe/return, RTC/time preparation, p5 arming, writer full write and automatic H616 return remain coordinator-owned H12 gates with immediate separate high-consequence review and applicable authorization, binding the new loader and writer hashes. Preserve 8 GB image sizing, immutable/persistent-state policy, profiles, pins, idle/heater protections and independent recovery.

decision.rationale: Approve bounded offline implementation toward the existing writerless goal under decision 0011 and .codex/current-goals.md. H13 establishes measured SD GTK/SSH, kernel-readonly root, installed spare identity and successful read-only live-stager admission. host-managed-boot-route-research-20260929.md resolves the earlier unknown: the exact old config lacks CMD_HASH/HASH_VERIFY/CRC32_VERIFY, and the old loader equals its pinned 40960-byte SPL plus FIT. Pinned cmd/Kconfig confirms these independent options. Enabling their supported upstream mechanisms in main U-Boot while preserving SPL/BL31/DT/default environment fixes the identified capability gap without a new boot policy or electrical settings. Before: current SD-only loader cannot select eMMC, the full loader cannot run required integrity commands, and emmc_image_writer.c finish always powers off. After: a newly reviewed loader can use the unchanged SD hash-verifying script and accepted p5 selector, while only fully verified recovery-handoff PASS requests automatic reboot. Actual C source places its sole exact PASS after full readback hash; all refusal/failure paths use other statuses. This finalizer correction completes the authorized unattended goal rather than optional scope. Accepted bulk-transfer/QEMU second-boot evidence may be reused only if those paths remain unchanged. Approve one implementer in the named files, isolated 512 MiB build scratch and bounded receipts; no spending, licensing or authority change. Source/sandbox/syscall/QEMU evidence cannot establish H616 boot, reset, MMC mapping or physical return. Conditions below are acceptance gates; no physical operation is authorized by this design decision.

verification.rationale: Verified clean HEAD 301c0bf13acd9e275c298eb595c12462f3ec998a against recorded v2 run base 0e9a89893e970844a375b53f6a04b8cd8782e837: entire diff contains exactly the eight approved paths, with no unlisted files, deletions, unexpected modes or gitlinks. Inspected intervening history including coordinator record resumption and the separate public RTC preparation document; these predate this run base. Complete approved decision, proposal/requirements/scope, evidence document and every source hash match; submitted evidence is bound to actual HEAD. smbr-01 passes using unchanged independently reproduced loader assembly/admission/fault checks: exact retained 40960-byte SPL, extracted BL31/DT/default environment, three-option effective config, actual command symbols and linked ELF-to-FIT equality. Rechecked retained loader and pinned compatible sandbox good/bad SHA/CRC log hashes; loader remains physically unvalidated. Reported isolated build scratch 319037904 logical bytes/417 MiB stays within 512 MiB, with bounded loader/preimage/receipts/capture and streaming preservation. smbr-02 passes after capture repair: entrypoint reserves and fsyncs private fresh capture before UART access, persists/fsyncs bounded raw RX before interpreting gates and before TX, retains available transcript on refusal, and stops on append/short-write/fsync errors. Reproduced all 21 serial tests without skips, including actual run entrypoint existing/symlink/unwritable capture, initial flush, countdown/hash persistence failures, timeout/refusal retention, success and exact 1 MiB limit; the initial reproduced late-capture failure is corrected. Fixed U-Boot command/hash/count/prompt gates, bridge identity/arbitration, unchanged script/root/envelope checks, no control-line changes or blind retry remain intact. smbr-03 passes with meaningful bounded before/after reproduction, source/artifact receipts, documentation/links and independent review. smbr-04 passes by reuse of unchanged independently executed both-mode exact-PASS/status/returned-reboot tests and ARM64 compilation; rechecked QMP result/init/initrd/serial hashes for actual guest RESET on PASS and SHUTDOWN on FAILED_FINAL_ENV. The C diff remains limited to finish; admission, signed claims, marker consumption, environment-last transfer and full readback remain unchanged, permitting reuse of their accepted bulk/normal-boot evidence. Diff/cached checks, Markdown targets and lock/indexed gitlinks pass. No hardware or private evidence was accessed. This passes only the approved offline delivery: new-loader physical SD boot/MMC mapping, warm RTC retention, p5 staging/arming, exact newly hashed writer full-write and automatic H616 return remain coordinator-owned H12 gates requiring separate immediate reviews and applicable authorization; no hardware profile or release is certified.
